## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs:`)

## Pre-Merge Checklist
- [ ] `make check` passes locally with zero warnings/errors (`cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace`, `shellcheck install.sh uninstall.sh`)
- [ ] New or updated unit tests cover the change
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `locales/en_us.yml`) updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal hostnames, or hardcoded absolute user paths committed
